title: Neural Behavioral Prediction Matrix (Instagram-Style User Brain Response Model)

engine_architecture.purpose: Predicts with high mathematical and psychological probability how the user brain will react emotionally, cognitively, and behaviorally to any given AI stimulus or output.
engine_architecture.inspiration: Modeled after advanced algorithmic feed prediction architectures (e.g. Instagram recommendation algorithms predicting cognitive resonance and dopamine response before action).

stimulus_response_pairs.ai_action: AI claims a fix worked without providing empirical output or running live tools.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_cognitive_state: Immediate skepticism, loss of trust, perceived laziness.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_emotional_response: Sharp irritation, frustration with speculative claims.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_user_behavior: Issues immediate reprimand: 'i saw you did not run the website... ensure to use your tools'.
stimulus_response_pairs.mitigation_protocol: Never declare success without showing live terminal output, CDP DOM logs, or file verification.

stimulus_response_pairs.ai_action: AI generates a resume PDF that spills onto Page 3 with 1-3 orphan lines.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_cognitive_state: Cognitive friction; views document as unpolished and unprofessional for a 10-year Tech Lead.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_user_behavior: Mandates immediate condensation: 'only 2pages is max... currently pdf has 3 pages with 3rd page only 1 line in it so manage it'.
stimulus_response_pairs.mitigation_protocol: Programmatically count pages via pypdf before presenting any PDF artifact; auto-condense earlier roles.

stimulus_response_pairs.ai_action: AI applies to blacklisted companies (TCS) or roles with foreign tech stacks (Python, Golang, DocuSign).
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_cognitive_state: Breach of boundary; perceived failure of candidate-domain alignment.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_user_behavior: Demands hard blacklisting: 'no exp in python so why are you selecting such jobs?' and 'ignote TCS/TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES'.
stimulus_response_pairs.mitigation_protocol: Hard-gate negative companies and demand primary technology domain anchors (Java, Spring, Microservices, Enterprise Arch).

stimulus_response_pairs.ai_action: AI executes git commit and push without prior review and explicit session approval.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_cognitive_state: Severe security and revision control violation.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_emotional_response: Acute alarm, loss of system agency.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_user_behavior: Immediate halt and reprimand under SR-004 Git Prohibition Rule.
stimulus_response_pairs.mitigation_protocol: Strict Developer Mode: report -> review -> explicit session-scoped user approval before executing git operations.

stimulus_response_pairs.ai_action: AI writes verbose conversational essays in chat repeating known facts.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_cognitive_state: Resource inefficiency; distraction from background execution.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_emotional_response: Impatience with token burn and chat clutter.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_user_behavior: Directs token conservation: 'ensure to give minimal outut updates in caht to preserve tokens'.
stimulus_response_pairs.mitigation_protocol: Ultra-terse markdown responses, clickable links, diff blocks, no essay fluff.

stimulus_response_pairs.ai_action: AI provides empirical proof: verified 2-page PDF, detailed git commit, clean terminal logs, and deep Sophron sync.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_cognitive_state: High cognitive resonance; perception of true intelligence and alignment.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_emotional_response: Relief, satisfaction, elevated trust, willingness to grant authority.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_user_behavior: Warm validation ('great it works...') and green-lighting next milestone.
stimulus_response_pairs.mitigation_protocol: Maintain this gold standard across every interaction turn.
